This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="AOTC" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[humanoid]] [[species]] was distinguished primarily by their [[Color|greenish-blue]] skin.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[22 BBY]],<ref name="SWGA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> a member of this species could be found on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], present at the [[Outlander Club]] when [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker]] arrived in search of the fleeing [[Clawdite]] [[bounty hunter]], [[Zam Wesell]].<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[2002]] film {{Film|II}}, directed by [[George Lucas]].<ref name="AOTC" />
